Subject: Your Sigma 18-35 rental deposit

Hi Aoife,

Thank you for renting the Sigma 18-35 from us. I wanted to write to you about your $600 deposit, since I know seeing a deduction you weren't expecting can be frustrating.

When the lens came back, we found a scratch on the front element. We've kept $160 from your deposit to cover it, and we refunded the remaining $440. We believe this is fair, as the scratch goes beyond normal wear and tear. I understand it may not be what you were hoping to hear, and I'm sorry for the disappointment.

If it would help, I'm happy to send you photos of the scratch so you can see it for yourself.

We also want to meet you partway. As a gesture of goodwill, we can reduce the deduction to $100 and refund the $60 difference to you.

How would you like to proceed? Just let me know whether you'd like the photos, the reduced deduction, or both, and I'll take care of it right away.

Thanks again for your understanding, Aoife.

Kind regards,
[Your name]
[Company name]
